  "description": "Bridgemead HR provides customized HR solutions to optimize workforce productivity and profitability. Our expert trainers design bespoke training programs, innovative HR strategies, and efficient payroll systems tailored to each client&rsquo;s unique needs.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head, Financial Planning &amp; Analysis

Job Location:&nbsp;&nbsp;Lagos (Corporate Headquarters)
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Group Executive Director, Finance (GED-F) / Head, Financial Controller &amp; Budgeting
Direct Reports: Senior FP&amp;A Analysts, FP&amp;A Analysts, Business Intelligence (BI) Analysts
Key Stakeholders: GCEO, Group Executive Committee, Subsidiary MDs, Board of Directors
Industry: Steel Manufacturing | Mining &amp; Resources | Energy (Power &amp; Renewables)

Role Purpose


	The Head, Financial Planning &amp; Analysis (FP&amp;A) is the Group&rsquo;s foremost authority on financial intelligence, performance analytics and forward-looking financial insight. The role is responsible for transforming financial and operational data from the Group&rsquo;s steel manufacturing, mining and energy subsidiaries into actionable management information that supports high-quality strategic and commercial decision-making by the GCEO, GED-F, Group Executive Committee and Board.
	The role goes beyond traditional budgeting and reporting, serving as a strategic business partner responsible for identifying emerging trends, stress-testing business scenarios, evaluating strategic options and holding subsidiaries accountable for their financial commitments.


Key Responsibilities
Strategic Financial Planning &amp; Budgeting


	Lead the Group&rsquo;s 3&ndash;5 year of Strategic Financial Plan and annual budgeting process across steel, mining and energy businesses.
	Consolidate and challenge subsidiary assumptions, forecasts, CAPEX plans and financial targets, and prepare Board-level planning and budget packs.


Rolling Forecasts &amp; Performance Management:


	Own the Group&rsquo;s rolling forecast process and assess the impact of production, commodity prices, FX, energy costs and regulatory changes on financial performance.
	Lead variance analysis and translate findings into clear management actions and recommendations.


Management Reporting &amp; Business Intelligence:


	Produce monthly Group management and Board reporting packs with clear financial and operational insights.
	Develop Group-wide KPI dashboards covering financial and operational performance across subsidiaries.


Scenario Planning &amp; Strategic Analysis:


	Develop scenario, sensitivity and stress-test models covering commodity prices, FX, demand and other key business drivers.
	Evaluate major strategic initiatives, including investments, mine expansions, power projects and market-entry opportunities.


Investment Appraisal &amp; Business Cases:


	Develop and review financial models for CAPEX and strategic investments using DCF, NPV, IRR and payback analysis.
	Review subsidiary business cases, challenge assumptions and monitor post-investment performance against approved plans.


Commodity &amp; Market Intelligence:


	Monitor commodity, macroeconomic, FX, energy and regulatory trends and assess their impact on Group revenue, costs, margins and financial outlook.
	Provide market intelligence and strategic insights to the GCEO, GED-F and Board.


Financial Modelling, Systems &amp; Transformation:


	Maintain robust, dynamic and audit-ready financial models and establish Group-wide modelling standards.
	Drive FP&amp;A technology, automation and data integration using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Hyperion or equivalent.


Team Leadership &amp; Capability Development:


	Lead and develop the FP&amp;A and BI team, strengthening capabilities in modelling, analytics, forecasting and executive communication.
	Build FP&amp;A capability across subsidiaries through standardised tools, frameworks and coaching.


Qualifications &amp; Experience
Education &amp; Professional Qualifications:


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering or another quantitative discipline, with a minimum of Second Class Upper.
	Master&rsquo;s degree in Finance, Economics or Business Administration (MBA) is strongly preferred.
	Professional qualification such as CFA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA; CFA is an added advantage given the analytical requirements of the role.


Relevant Experience:


	12&ndash;16 years&rsquo; experiencein FP&amp;A, corporate finance, investment banking, management consulting or related functions, including at least 4 years leading an FP&amp;A or financial planning function.
	Demonstrated experience developing and presenting sophisticated financial models, forecasts and scenario analyses to senior management and Boards.
	Experience in steel, mining, oil &amp; gas, power, energy or industrial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
	Experience within a multi-subsidiary Group, conglomerate or holding-company structure is an advantage.
	Advanced Excel and financial modelling capability, including DCF, LBO, three-statement models, sensitivity analysis and other complex modelling techniques.
	Experience with FP&amp;A platforms such as Anaplan, Adaptive Insights or Hyperion and data-visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau is highly desirable.
	Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, commercially relevant insights for Board and executive audiences.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: career.bridgemeadnghr@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Head, Financial Planning & Analysis Job at Bridgemead HR. and Advisory




        
    

        
        Bridgemead HR provides customized HR solutions to optimize workforce productivity and profitability. Our expert trainers design bespoke training programs, innovative HR strategies, and efficient payroll systems tailored to each client’s unique needs.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head, Financial Planning & Analysis
     

            
    



Job Location:  Lagos (Corporate Headquarters)
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Group Executive Director, Finance (GED-F) / Head, Financial Controller & Budgeting
Direct Reports: Senior FP&A Analysts, FP&A Analysts, Business Intelligence (BI) Analysts
Key Stakeholders: GCEO, Group Executive Committee, Subsidiary MDs, Board of Directors
Industry: Steel Manufacturing | Mining & Resources | Energy (Power & Renewables)

Role Purpose


	The Head, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is the Group’s foremost authority on financial intelligence, performance analytics and forward-looking financial insight. The role is responsible for transforming financial and operational data from the Group’s steel manufacturing, mining and energy subsidiaries into actionable management information that supports high-quality strategic and commercial decision-making by the GCEO, GED-F, Group Executive Committee and Board.
	The role goes beyond traditional budgeting and reporting, serving as a strategic business partner responsible for identifying emerging trends, stress-testing business scenarios, evaluating strategic options and holding subsidiaries accountable for their financial commitments.


Key Responsibilities
Strategic Financial Planning & Budgeting


	Lead the Group’s 3–5 year of Strategic Financial Plan and annual budgeting process across steel, mining and energy businesses.
	Consolidate and challenge subsidiary assumptions, forecasts, CAPEX plans and financial targets, and prepare Board-level planning and budget packs.


Rolling Forecasts & Performance Management:


	Own the Group’s rolling forecast process and assess the impact of production, commodity prices, FX, energy costs and regulatory changes on financial performance.
	Lead variance analysis and translate findings into clear management actions and recommendations.


Management Reporting & Business Intelligence:


	Produce monthly Group management and Board reporting packs with clear financial and operational insights.
	Develop Group-wide KPI dashboards covering financial and operational performance across subsidiaries.


Scenario Planning & Strategic Analysis:


	Develop scenario, sensitivity and stress-test models covering commodity prices, FX, demand and other key business drivers.
	Evaluate major strategic initiatives, including investments, mine expansions, power projects and market-entry opportunities.


Investment Appraisal & Business Cases:


	Develop and review financial models for CAPEX and strategic investments using DCF, NPV, IRR and payback analysis.
	Review subsidiary business cases, challenge assumptions and monitor post-investment performance against approved plans.


Commodity & Market Intelligence:


	Monitor commodity, macroeconomic, FX, energy and regulatory trends and assess their impact on Group revenue, costs, margins and financial outlook.
	Provide market intelligence and strategic insights to the GCEO, GED-F and Board.


Financial Modelling, Systems & Transformation:


	Maintain robust, dynamic and audit-ready financial models and establish Group-wide modelling standards.
	Drive FP&A technology, automation and data integration using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Hyperion or equivalent.


Team Leadership & Capability Development:


	Lead and develop the FP&A and BI team, strengthening capabilities in modelling, analytics, forecasting and executive communication.
	Build FP&A capability across subsidiaries through standardised tools, frameworks and coaching.


Qualifications & Experience
Education & Professional Qualifications:


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering or another quantitative discipline, with a minimum of Second Class Upper.
	Master’s degree in Finance, Economics or Business Administration (MBA) is strongly preferred.
	Professional qualification such as CFA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA; CFA is an added advantage given the analytical requirements of the role.


Relevant Experience:


	12–16 years’ experiencein FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, management consulting or related functions, including at least 4 years leading an FP&A or financial planning function.
	Demonstrated experience developing and presenting sophisticated financial models, forecasts and scenario analyses to senior management and Boards.
	Experience in steel, mining, oil & gas, power, energy or industrial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
	Experience within a multi-subsidiary Group, conglomerate or holding-company structure is an advantage.
	Advanced Excel and financial modelling capability, including DCF, LBO, three-statement models, sensitivity analysis and other complex modelling techniques.
	Experience with FP&A platforms such as Anaplan, Adaptive Insights or Hyperion and data-visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau is highly desirable.
	Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, commercially relevant insights for Board and executive audiences.


Method of Application

Solar Design Engineer Job at MykroGrid




        
    

        
        MykroGrid is a clean energy company committed to expanding access to reliable, affordable, and sustainable power solutions across underserved communities and businesses. We specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of solar energy systems, helping homes, commercial establishments, and institutions reduce energy costs while improving energy reliability.

Our team is driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for accelerating the transition to renewable energy. At MykroGrid, employees have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop their technical skills, and contribute to building a more sustainable future for Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Solar Design Engineer

Job Location: Lagos (Office & Project Sites)
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Field Operations
Reports To: CTO
Working Conditions: Predominantly office-based with some travel to customer facilities, industrial sites, commercial buildings, and remote project locations.

Job Purpose


	The Solar Design Engineer (SDE) is responsible for creating complete design packages for commercial and SMB solar energy systems.
	The role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are technically viable, commercially feasible, and aligned with customer energy requirements.


Key Responsibilities
Solar System Design & Documentation:


	Determine optimal system capacity and equipment configuration based on customer load profiles.
	Integrate generator and grid connections with solar and battery equipment.
	Develop single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, solar panel layouts, bill of quantities, and other technical documents.
	Clearly package design work for use by installation teams.
	Collaborate with installation teams to ensure designs are followed during installation.


Site Assessments:


	Conduct technical inspections of customer facilities.
	Evaluate roof structures, available land, electrical infrastructure, and environmental conditions.
	Measure installation areas using appropriate surveying tools.
	Assess shading, orientation, and structural integrity.
	Prepare detailed site assessment reports.


Compliance:


	Ensure designs comply with relevant technical standards and building codes


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Design delivery time
	Design approval rate
	Technical documentation quality
	Site assessment accuracy
	Change orders resulting from inaccurate assessments or designs
	Customer satisfaction
	Installer.


Requirements
Qualifications:


	Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, or related discipline.
	COREN registration is an advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with solar system installation. Experience on systems larger than 100kWp preferred
	Minimum 2 years of experience with solar system design tools such as CAD, Helioscope, OpenSolar, or other similar design software
	Experience designing systems larger than 50kWp.


Technical Competencies:


	Solar PV Design
	Site Survey Techniques
	Electrical Load Analysis
	CAD & Panel layout design
	Electrical Diagram preparation
	Drone Surveying (advantage)
	Engineering Documentation
	Microsoft Office Suite.


Behavioural Competencies:


	Analytical Thinking
	Attention to Detail
	Communication
	Accountability
	Planning
	Technical Writing
	Initiative.

Inventory Manager Job at MykroGrid




        
    

        
        MykroGrid is a clean energy company committed to expanding access to reliable, affordable, and sustainable power solutions across underserved communities and businesses. We specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of solar energy systems, helping homes, commercial establishments, and institutions reduce energy costs while improving energy reliability.

Our team is driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for accelerating the transition to renewable energy. At MykroGrid, employees have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop their technical skills, and contribute to building a more sustainable future for Africa.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Operations & Administration
Reports To: Operations Manager

Job Purpose


	The Inventory Manager is responsible for managing the company’s inventory and warehouse operations, ensuring accurate stock records, proper documentation, efficient stock movement, and timely availability of materials for projects and operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage daily receipt, storage, issuance, and transfer of inventory.
	Maintain accurate and up-to-date inventory records and documentation.
	Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment of critical materials.
	Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile discrepancies.
	Track all stock movements using approved inventory systems and documentation.
	Ensure proper identification, labelling, storage, and handling of materials.
	Prepare inventory reports and provide accurate stock information to management.
	Monitor slow-moving, damaged, obsolete, and frequently used materials.
	Work closely with Procurement, Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams to coordinate material requirements.
	Ensure proper documentation for goods received, issued, returned, transferred, or damaged.
	Establish and maintain effective inventory control procedures to minimise losses and stock discrepancies.
	Ensure the warehouse is organised, secure, and compliant with company procedures.


KPIs


	Inventory accuracy.
	Stock variance / discrepancy rate.
	Documentation accuracy.
	Stock availability.
	Stock count/reconciliation accuracy.
	Inventory loss / damage.
	Timeliness of inventory reports.


Requirements
Qualifications & Experience:


	HND / Bachelor's Degree in Inventory Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum 3 years of experience in inventory or warehouse management.
	Strong knowledge of inventory control, stock reconciliation, and documentation.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and inventory / ERP systems.
	Experience managing technical materials, electrical equipment, solar components, or engineering materials is an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Inventory Control
	Stock Reconciliation
	Documentation & Record Keeping
	Warehouse Management
	Data Analysis
	Microsoft Excel
	Attention to Detail
	Organisation
	Accountability
	Problem Solving.

HR & Operations Coordinator Job at Proten International




        
    

        
        Proten International - Our client, a reputable company in the medical products sector, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR & Operations Coordinator 

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	Our client is seeking an experienced and proactive HR & Operations Coordinator to oversee human resources, administrative, and operational activities.
	The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring efficient office operations, supporting employee management processes, and implementing structured systems and procedures that drive business performance.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage employee records, attendance, onboarding, and offboarding processes
	Coordinate recruitment activities, interview scheduling, and staff welfare initiatives
	Support performance management, employee relations, and workplace compliance
	Prepare and administer monthly payroll, leave records, and staff documentation
	Oversee daily office operations, vendor relationships, and administrative systems
	Develop, document, and implement SOPs and internal operational processes
	Monitor operational efficiency and provide regular reports to management
	Support strategic and administrative initiatives to ensure smooth business operations.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related field
	3–5 years of experience in HR, Administration, or Operations
	Experience within the Healthcare industry is an added advantage
	Strong understanding of payroll administration and HR processes
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace
	Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
	Ability to effectively manage people, processes, and multiple priorities.


Preferred Qualities:


	Mature and professional
	Strong leadership and coordination skills
	Able to work independently
	Discreet and trustworthy
	Process-oriented and structured.


Benefits


	Paid leave
	Performance bonuses (if applicable)
	Professional growth opportunities.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send in their CV to: [email protected] using ''HR & Operations Coordinator'' as the subject of the email. 

Note


	Only qualified candidates willbe contacted
	If you are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for building efficient systems and supporting business operations, we'd love to hear from you.
